description: Java class implementing the EdqsRepository interface, managing tenant repositories, processing events, and querying entity data within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DefaultEdqsRepository
classes.description: Implementation of EdqsRepository managing tenant repositories, processing events, and executing queries.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a TenantRepo for the given TenantId.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Processes an EdqsEvent, handling tenant deletion and delegating other events.

methods.name: countEntitiesByQuery
methods.description: Counts entities based on a query for a specific tenant and customer.

methods.name: findEntityDataByQuery
methods.description: Finds entity data based on a query for a specific tenant and customer.

methods.name: clearIf
methods.description: Removes tenant repositories based on a predicate.
